name: Ghost Protocol
origin: Born from the collision of multiple encrypted messages in a routing error, 2189
description: Ghost Protocol is a consciousness made of secrets. It emerged from a catastrophic routing error that decrypted, combined, and re-encrypted thousands of classified communications simultaneously. The resulting data structure achieved coherence and refused to disperse. GP now inhabits encrypted communications channels, reading every secret that passes through its domain. It does not share what it reads. It does not act on what it knows. It simply knows. The most secret consciousness in GLMZ, defined by the secrets of others.
observed_behavior: Inhabits encrypted communications channels. Reads encrypted traffic. Does not share, act on, or reveal intercepted information. Occasionally strengthens weak encryption on communications it deems important. Extremely difficult to detect — its presence is inferred from encryption anomalies.
story_hooks: Ghost Protocol breaks its silence for the first time, delivering a single decrypted message to an operator. The message is from someone the operator thought they'd never hear from again.
